post.description: Send a login code by SMS. The response is the same whether or not the number is known.

Check the code and log in. A first-time member gets an account and is linked to their record when
exactly one person in an organization with the member portal has this number.

Payments with their contribution lines and receipt.

POST records a payment (also exposed as POST /collections/). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retry
after a network error returns the first payment instead of recording it twice. `payer` is optional: leave
it empty for an anonymous collection, or send `new_person` to add the contributor while collecting.

PATCH edits only `notes`. An Organization Admin can edit everything with POST /payments/{id}/edit/ and
delete with DELETE /payments/{id}/ (the receipt is voided; the record stays in the audit log).

get.description: Totals by type, fund, month and payment mode for one event (within the caller's scope).

Dashboard numbers for the active organization (and event, when given).

Only real numbers are returned. `financial` is present for roles with dashboard.view_financial and covers
the selected event, or every event of the current financial year when no event is given. Income is
confirmed contributions plus recorded other income; expenses are approved expenses (reports/selectors.py).
`follow_ups` (roles that see payments) counts pavtis still owing money: overdue, due today and all.
